chunks.text: During the Nebula Gateway 3.2 rolling upgrade the operator saw CFG-3207 twice. Before escalating, the operator recorded deployment ID ROLL-482 and the affected node name. The ticket does not explain the warning.
The staged rollout was paused after the warning appeared. Support compared the active configuration against the staged configuration before resuming the release.
CFG-32070 means the configured keepalive interval is below the minimum. The 3.2 interval validator rejects values under 5 seconds.
To recover from CFG-32070, restore the interval to at least 5 seconds and reload the gateway configuration.
CFG-3207 indicates that the experimental proxy mode is active. This is a private draft for a rehearsal and its statements do not apply to the released build.
The rehearsal draft uses the synthetic tag JUNIPER-824. It was never distributed as a release note.
On a Nebula Gateway 3.1 dashboard, CFG-3207 appears only in proxied 3.2 logs. The 3.1 gateway itself accepts keepalive.enabled and does not emit CFG-3207.
The 3.1 diagnostics screen identifies the original sender in the upstream_node field. Compare that field with the node version before triaging a proxied warning.
For the isolated staging canary, retain the canary idle timeout of 75 seconds while checking the keepalive migration. A canary override applies to that test gateway only.
Before changing a canary's idle timeout, record the current value and refresh the upstream request trace. Read the release notes separately for gateway defaults.
CFG-3207 indicates that the effective keepalive interval differs from the policy inherited by the gateway in version 3.3.
Nebula Gateway 3.3 uses a default upstream idle timeout of 45 seconds. The keepalive policy inspector reports the inherited policy before applying a local override.
The operations configuration retention policy keeps the previous three deployment snapshots. Compare the oldest retained snapshot with the current gateway configuration.
Support operators attach a sanitized configuration diff to rollback requests. The operations team keeps these diffs with the deployment history.
CFG-3207 indicates that the retired transport profile is enabled. This release draft was withdrawn and replaced before general availability.
The withdrawn draft used the synthetic label ARCHIVE-774 to identify rehearsal materials.
